bio: Situated at the centre of the old Covent Garden Market, the Crusting Pipe is a traditional wine bar, featuring candlelit tables and an outdoor seating area which offers a comfortable atmosphere in which to enjoy Afternoon Tea.  With a new menu for 2023, guests can expect a delightful variation of the classic sweets and treats including freshly cut finger sandwiches and savouries, freshly baked scones and pastries and your choice of teas. Make it a special occasion with a flute of their much-loved Célébration Champagne.  The Crusting Pipe is just a short walk from Covent Garden tube station and is a perfect destination for those who are lovers of West End shows for their amazing live operatic perfomances that take place regularly in the courtyard.
